summary: Added a hard monthly-window shadow-test gate to Phase 2 pool admission. Three new config flags (PHASE2_MONTHLY_ADMISSION_ENABLED, _MIN_PROFITABLE_RATIO, _MIN_MONTHS) were added to config.py with rationale comments. A helper function _evaluate_rule_on_window (wrapping CPUBacktestEngine.simulate_rule_set) was added to phase2_rule_pool.py. A post-filter block was inserted into Rule_Pool_Generator.run() after the existing pool-admission filter and before pool saving: it builds monthly windows from the slimmed train DataFrame, evaluates each pool rule on each window, and keeps only rules whose profitable_ratio >= 0.5. The gate logs pre/post counts, median profitable_ratio, and p10. Graceful degradation is implemented: if the gate would empty the pool, a warning is logged and the original pool is kept. A unit test file (test_phase2_monthly_admission.py) with 5 tests covers: filtering by profitability, disabled-flag preservation, min-months skip, graceful degradation, and boundary (exact 0.5 ratio). All 121 existing+new unit tests pass.
notes_for_reviewer: The helper function _evaluate_rule_on_window is placed in phase2_rule_pool.py (not validation/monthly_windows.py) because it is tightly coupled to the pool entry format (conditions key) and Phase 2 config constants (PHASE2_TP, PHASE2_SL, PHASE2_CAPITAL_PCT).
The build_monthly_windows call uses self._train_df (the slimmed, sampled train DataFrame) which preserves the 'datetime' meta column needed by the window builder.
The import for build_monthly_windows is lazy (inside the if-block) to avoid potential circular imports at module load time.
The gate gracefully degrades: if all rules are filtered out, the original pool is kept and a warning is logged. The original pool is always list(pool) — i.e., a shallow copy — so no aliasing issues.
The gate logs median and p10 profitable_ratio at INFO level, labeled with the direction.
The unit test uses _DeterministicEvaluator (monkeypatch) to return canned returns per rule per window, avoiding any real backtest engine dependency.

The test file's _run_gate helper accesses _evaluate_rule_on_window through the module attribute (import gpu_fuzzy_trader.phases.phase2_rule_pool as _p2rp) to ensure monkeypatch.setattr works correctly.
Only 3 files changed; no refactoring of unrelated code. The PNG changes in outputs/reports/ are test artifacts from existing unit tests and were not staged.
